_note: The newspapers as they look on a front page. 'name' must match the name the game uses ({region} stands for a region's name); 'style' is tabloid (red nameplate, shouting headlines), broadsheet (blackletter nameplate, ears, sober headlines) or local (plain capitals between rules). 'motto', 'price' and 'founded' are printed on the nameplate. All of this is only for show: the rules don't read it.
